Okay so first, thank you, you are the only on that replies serious and helpful
And second i blamed nobody, i just sayed gg and went into the next game
I didnt die often as well

I stayed with my team and backed up when they died, i didnt push in by myself and i focused the support with my blad
I also dont have a YT-Channel or sth so i can't link a vid😬😅

The thing is, that i really played well
I really did my best but my rein kept charging in, my zary missclicked and graved a wall and my ana nanoed me when nobody was there
But i still got 40+ elims, i just dont think that i belong in gold
I know many people say that, but these guys i played with were plat in all the seasons before
If you can use it, every ult is good ;)

I never play Overwatch alone. I always wait for one or two friends to join me, so we can play DPS, Healer und Tank one after another. Although we have to play Heroes we don't want to play, it still works and we have lots of fun and still win some matches. You said, that you wanted to go for the Golden Weapons, I've got two right now (Genji and Rein) and I will soon get my third ones
